title: Persistence writer ticks of 2-4.5 s under full-gate load miss durable-write deadlines across test registration, evaluation submission, and named-root naming and release
outcome: Persistence writer ticks of 2-4.5 s under full-gate load miss durable-write deadlines across test registration, evaluation submission, and named-root naming and release
acceptance: A recorded measurement (tick duration, queue depth and what each tick writes) under one running full gate plus one warm establishes the cause of the 2-4.5 s writer ticks seen on 2026-10-18, with falsifiable hypotheses discriminated (I/O contention with the gate, state-snapshot size, lock hold in StateInner, or something else)

The fix keeps durable-write acknowledgement within budget under the documented concurrent-run cap, or every affected surface (test registration, evaluation submission, root naming, clear and release) returns a typed, retry-safe 'not applied' or 'pending, retry the same request' instead of an unknown-outcome 500; deadlines are not blindly inflated
Focused tests and a reproduction under load show the affected surfaces succeed or answer definitively; full gate plus an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding
